entities.name: Tyrannion of Amisus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tyrannion was a Greek grammarian brought to Rome as a war captive and slave. He is also known as Tyrannion the Elder, in order to distinguish him from his pupil who is known as Tyrannion the Younger.
